messages.text: Just quick question, how much coin can be mined on average per day or month?
Read the harlo duo pack b30 h15 dual page
Ran the power-cost calculator
Searched the catalog · Harlo Duo Pack B30 H15 Dual

Honest answer: at 45 TH/s combined, the Duo Pack is about stacking sats steadily plus a long-shot solo block, not big daily income. The exact amount moves with BTC price and difficulty, and your power rate decides whether it's worth it.

Tell me the state or country it'll run in, and your rate per kWh if you know it, and I'll run the real monthly sats, power cost and break-even for you.

The pack is $1,799 right now (B30 $899 + H15 Dual $999 separately).
I'm in England I'm unsure of standard house kWh, does this help?
Ran the power-cost calculator

Helpful, yes. UK standard rates are around 25p per kWh, worth checking your bill.

The D. Pack pulls about 985W flat out, so roughly 24 kWh a day, about 710 kWh a month. At 25p that's around £175 a month in electricity.

At UK prices that's steep against what 45 TH/s stacks, so be honest with yourself: this is sat stacking and a solo-block lottery ticket, not profit. Running both in ECO mode cuts power a lot.

What's your goal, stacking BTC or chasing a block?
Stacking would have been the goal, need to make a free electricity generator that runs an extremely high kWh number first I guess :D
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 low power small bitcoin miner

Ha, that would solve it. Solar plus a battery is genuinely how a lot of UK folks make this work.

Until then, small and efficient is the honest route. The Hammer BC04 is $249, 6 TH/s at about 100W, so roughly £18 a month at 25p. Same sats per TH as a big rig, a fraction of the bill, and you still get the solo-block ticket.

Want the link, or shall I put one in a cart for you?
Can I have a link for now pls? Need to convince the better half also :)

Here you go: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-bc04

$249, 6 TH/s, about 100W, quiet at roughly 50 dB, WiFi or Ethernet, and it ships with the UK plug matched to your address.

If the Duo Pack is still in the running for comparison: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-duo-pack-b30-h15-dual

The selling point for the better half is the running cost, around £18 a month versus £175. Shout if you want me to build a cart.
Will do, thank you so much for the help and info, God bless have a good evening :)
Used the chat-interview skill

Thanks, you too. Enjoy the evening.

Before you go, one thing: what do you think your other half's first objection will be, the cost or the noise?
Just being unsure how it works what its about, etc, kinda getting over the suspicion of scams and stuff, but this is easily done, just show her the info :)

Fair, and a healthy instinct. The honest version: it's a small box on your WiFi, pointed at a mining pool, earning a tiny share of Bitcoin for the work it does. No promises, no subscription.

Our Discord is open if you both want to see real owners talking: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

What would settle the scam worry for her, seeing one actually running?
Just when I show her how it works what it does, I guess a vid would be handy if there's any links? Ty for the discord, jotted now

I don't want to point you at a video I haven't checked, so: the product page has the photos and full specs, and Discord is where owners post their units actually running, dashboards, hashrate, the lot. Ask in there and someone will happily show you theirs.

If you'd rather, I can ask our team tomorrow whether we have an official setup video and get the link sent to you. Just say the word.
No no it good, just wish me luck! Thanks again :)

Good luck. Lead with the £18 a month and the fact it's the size of a small speaker, that usually does it.

If she's on board, come back and I'll sort the cart. Have a good evening.
Ty you again definately will do :)
Anytime. I'm here whenever you're ready, and the Discord folks are good company in the meantime. Take care.
